args.text:
Batch of 8 runs, all 8 accepted. 1 flagged, 7 cleared.
Flagged: r08 (summary_outlier). Its largest flank difference is at 1105 µm (z 16.4). That is past its own 684 µm growth zone, so the curvature-rate profile has a different shape from the rest of the batch. All its checks pass. Its REGR peak is 1.2 %/h below the median (51.93 vs 53.16 %/h). On its own that would just mean a slower root.
Cleared: r01–r07. Every final check passes, or was not run because the width-free ratio was reported. Every run peaks at 421 µm and has a 674–684 µm growth zone. The large |z| values come from a tiny batch MAD and stand for small differences: +0.12 %/h on the REGR peak for r05 and r07, and −10 µm on the growth zone for r02–r04.
What the flagged run shows: only one run was flagged, so there is no shared pattern. Its fault is the flank difference (differential growth) sitting outside the growth zone. Its checks, remedies and peak position look normal.
